title: Former Unit 8200 Officers Raise $34 Million for Agentic SecOps Startup Mave
description: Mave is a Tel Aviv-based startup founded by former Unit 8200 officers that uses AI agents to automate and enhance security operations by investigating alerts across existing security stacks. The company aims to address the challenge of overwhelming data and slow response times in enterprise security teams by leveraging AI to keep pace with AI-assisted attackers. Mave's solution integrates with existing security tools to provide near real-time context-based reasoning, reducing alert fatigue and improving operational efficiency. The startup emphasizes controlled AI autonomy with approval gates and audit trails to mitigate risks associated with automated actions. Currently, Mave does not offer full automation but focuses on augmenting human decision-making in security operations. The company recently raised $34 million to accelerate AI research and expand its product offerings and global presence.
